about.label: About the project
about.title: About us
about.subtitle: DriveAndAlive is the result of our passion for the racing game genre. We created a title that combines a polished driving model with a dynamic weather system, diverse maps, and online mechanics — all in your pocket!
about.missionText: We want to prove that a mobile racing game doesn’t have to be either an extremely realistic simulator or a purely arcade experience. Our goal was simple: find the golden balance and create a game that, while offering a complex and believable driving model, still delivers pure fun when racing through twisty tracks.

privacy.label: Data security
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Learn how we protect your data and respect your privacy in the world of virtual racing.
privacy.p1: The controller of your personal data is DriveAndAlive Studio. You can contact us regarding privacy matters at: privacy@driveandalive.com.
privacy.p2: While using the game, we process only the data necessary for its operation:
privacy.li2_1: nickname, email address, password stored as an encrypted hash.
privacy.li2_2: lap times, achievements, selected tracks, ranking data.
privacy.li2_3: device model, operating system version, diagnostic data (error logs).
privacy.h3: Purposes and legal bases for data processing
privacy.p3: We process your data for the following purposes:
privacy.li3_1: Creating and managing a player account – legal basis: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR.
privacy.li3_2: Synchronization with global leaderboards and rankings – legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.
privacy.li3_3: Storing game settings, badges, and cloud saves – legal basis: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR.
privacy.li3_4: Statistical analysis and difficulty balancing – legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.
privacy.li3_5: Error diagnostics and app optimization – legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.
privacy.p3_2: We do not use profiling or automated decision‑making that produces legal effects.
privacy.li4_1: Account data – until the user deletes their account.
privacy.li4_2: Gameplay statistics – up to 24 months from the last activity.
privacy.li4_4: Cloud saves – until the account is deleted or the data is manually removed.
privacy.h5: Who has access to your data?
privacy.p5: We use only verified cloud service providers operating within the EEA. Your data is not sold to any third parties.
privacy.p6: Providing account data (email, password, nickname) is necessary to use the game. Technical data and gameplay statistics are collected automatically and are required for proper app functionality.
privacy.li7_3: erase your data (“right to be forgotten”),
privacy.li7_7: receive a package containing all telemetry related to your account.
privacy.p7_2: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the President of the Personal Data Protection Office.
privacy.p8: For privacy matters, you can contact us at: privacy@driveandalive.com.

cookies.label: Tracking settings
cookies.title: Cookies Policy
cookies.subtitle: Full transparency regarding the storage of small data files on your device.
cookies.p1: Cookies are small text files stored on the User’s device while using the Service. They contain, among other things, the website name, storage duration, and a unique session identifier that enables proper connection to your account or in‑game wallet. Cookies are not used to identify you as a person — they are used solely to support the Service’s functionality.
cookies.p2: The Service uses two main types of cookies:
cookies.li2_1: Enable the login mechanism, maintain an active user session (daa_user), and allow profile settings to be saved and content to display correctly. Disabling these cookies prevents the Service from functioning — the session would expire after every page refresh.
cookies.li2_2: Used to collect anonymous information about website traffic, such as which subpages are visited most often (e.g., Map Creator after an update). They do not allow identification of a specific user. If third‑party analytics tools are used, they operate only in anonymized form and do not process personal data.
cookies.p3: The Service primarily uses first‑party cookies that handle login and game settings. Third‑party cookies may appear only within analytical tools — if used, they operate anonymously.
cookies.li4_1: session cookies – removed after closing the browser.
cookies.li4_2: persistent cookies – stored for the period necessary for the Service to function (e.g., up to 30 days), unless the user deletes them earlier.
cookies.p5: Because the game is still in development, some settings (e.g., selected avatar) are stored in the browser’s Local Storage.
cookies.li5_1: Local Storage is not a cookie.
cookies.li5_2: It is not used for tracking or profiling.
cookies.li5_3: Clearing browser history may remove saved game settings.
cookies.p6: Web browsers allow cookies to be stored by default. The user may:
cookies.p6_2: Disabling technical cookies will immediately end the active session and may prevent the Service from functioning.
cookies.p7: Detailed information about personal data processing, including user rights, can be found in the Privacy Policy.

terms.label: Legal Framework of the Project
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: General conditions for the provision of services for the web platform and the DriveAndAlive game.
terms.p1: These Terms of Service take effect immediately upon interacting with the services associated with the project and define the rules for using the services provided through the data‑exchange portal and user tables, commonly referred to as DriveAndAlive.
terms.li2_1: Registration in the Service is voluntary and completely free.
terms.li2_2: The player must use a username (nickname) that is not vulgar, offensive, or violating the personal rights of others. Failure to comply may result in progress suspension and permanent account removal by the Administration.
terms.li2_3: Each User should register only one main Account, linked to the mobile version installed on their local device.
terms.p3_1: DriveAndAlive fully embraces esports mechanisms and the skills players refine over weeks of practice. Therefore, the following are strictly prohibited:
terms.li3_1: Using unofficial scripts or background programs that generate additional, fake points on racing tracks.
terms.li3_2: Modifying the game’s binary code to reduce gravity, artificially increase vehicle power, or bypass leaderboard limitations.
terms.p3_2: Violations result in permanent penalties, including lifetime server exclusion (Hard‑Ban system).
terms.h4: Map creation via the Map Creator module
terms.p4: Map Creator allows players to design their own routes. By creating racing tracks, you grant us a free, non‑exclusive license to continuously host and serve them on the platform’s global internal servers for the entire community.
terms.p5: The developers reserve the right to unannounced maintenance in order to implement essential network updates related to server databases and ranking systems. We make every effort to ensure that such downtime occurs only during nighttime hours.
